Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
Hey. Aren't you thirsty？ As a special treat, I can go get us something.
Sure, I'll take you up on it
●'ll go check it out
That doesn't happen often. Sure, I'll take you up on that.
Okay. Stay!
(What am I, a dog...？)
Sorry for the wait! I picked them out myself, so no complaining, okay？
Yeah, thanks!
Come on, ●'ll go get them.
Oh, how sweet of you. You have ten seconds, go!
(Like that's even possible.)
Sorry for the wait. They had a bunch of stuff, is this okay？
It's fine. I'm not heartless enough to complain after making you run to get it.
Kobayakawa
Aren't you tired？ There's a bench over there, let's sit down.
Yeah, sure.
It's nice and quiet here.
Let's rest here a while
Let's just rest a little bit
Let's rest here for a while.
Yeah. Taking it easy for a bit sounds nice.
Let's just rest for a little bit.
Okay. So, what are we doing next？
Haha, don't rush me like that.
Kobayakawa
It's a bit hot today. Maybe I didn't need a jacket. Should I take it off？
You should take it off
Won't you get sunburned？
You should take it off. Just don't forget it anywhere, okay？
I'm not gonna forget it.
Won't you get sunburned？
Oh... You might be right. Maybe I'll keep it on.
Kobayakawa
Isn't it kind of cold today？ I should've dressed warmer.
Why not come closer？
Want to go somewhere warm？
Why not come a little closer？ That should warm you up a bit.
...Your face looks kinda sleazy, so we're just holding hands. Here.
(It's not sleazy... is it？)
Hmm, nah, I'm good. You can at least block the wind for me, though.
Kobayakawa
Oh, look, a food stall. Can I go get something？
Sure, I'll wait here
●'ll go get us something
Okay, ●'ll wait right here.
Hold on a sec.
Here, this one's for you.
● get one too？ Thanks.
●'ll go get us some. Wait here, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hmm... Then I'll come with you.
That was worth waiting in line for.
Maybe it's the anticipation while waiting in line that makes it taste even better.
Kobayakawa
A cat! Aww, so cute▼ Hey, don't you want to have one too？
I'd rather be with ▲小早川＊▲
Of course I'd love to!
I'd rather be with you than a cat, ▲小早川＊▲.
That's not what I asked, geez. Aww, it's so cute~▼
Right？ Every home needs a cat♪
Kobayakawa
Whoa, the sun's really strong...
Want me to put tanning oil on you？
Want me to put sunscreen on you？
Oh, so you like a tan. Fine by me, but I'll put it on myself.
Yeah, good idea. Lend it to me if you have some. I'll put it on myself.
Kobayakawa
Great view, huh... What's on your mind？
I was admiring ▲小早川＊▲, not the view
I just got lost in the view
Sorry. Forget the view, I was admiring you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hmph, what a cliché line. ...Well, maybe it became a cliché because it works. Hehe.
I just got lost in the view.
I get that. Makes you want to pack this whole view up and take it home.
Kobayakawa
There sure are a lot of people. Is this a popular spot or something？
It's too noisy
It's nice and lively
It's pretty noisy. Does it bother you？
I wouldn't say I hate it. Though I do prefer somewhere a bit quieter.
It's nice when it's lively like this, right？
I guess. Depends on the time and place, though.
Kobayakawa
Hardly anyone's around. Did we find a hidden gem？
It's a little too quiet...
Nice and peaceful, right？
It's a little too quiet...
That's fine, isn't it？ It means we can talk in peace.
Yeah, I guess. Better than it being noisy.
Kobayakawa
We finally have a date, and it's raining.
I wish it were sunny
A rainy date isn't so bad, right？
I really wish it'd been sunny for our date.
Yeah, I guess so. Rain makes everything a hassle.
Hmm, I don't know. Guess it depends on your mindset.
Kobayakawa
Hey. Can I come over to your place on the way home today？
Yeah, of course!
Today's not a great day...
Alright, I'll leave you to it.
First things first though, let's enjoy our date!
Today's not a great day...
Oh. Fine, then. Guess you've got stuff you don't want me to see.
(What is she imagining...？)
Kobayakawa
Oh, a fortune teller. Looks like they do compatibility readings.
I don't buy into that stuff
I'm kind of curious
I don't buy into that stuff, so I'm not interested.
Right？ Glad you've got some common sense.
I'm kind of curious. Let's get a reading!
Wait, seriously？
Fortune Teller
Your compatibility is the best! A bright future is guaranteed!
Huh, best compatibility, she says. Not that it means much, but it doesn't feel bad.
(Best compatibility, huh!)
Your compatibility is quite good. Things should surely work out fine!
Hmm. Pretty average, then？ Well, we wouldn't be together if we didn't get along.
(Not bad, though I wish we'd gotten a better result.)
Your compatibility is... *cough, cough*!
What's that supposed to mean？ Is it good or bad...？
Haha, I couldn't really tell.
Kobayakawa
Pretty flowers. Wonder if someone's tending to them.
Flowers really are nice
This flower suits you, ▲小早川＊▲
Flowers really are nice. Even if I don't know their names, they're soothing.
Yeah, maybe. Heh, so you were thinking the same thing.
This flower suits you, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Really？ You probably mean that in a good way, right？ Then I'll take it.
Kobayakawa
Oh, she's in my class... And she's with her boyfriend, too.
Wonder what they think of us, ●
We win, ●!
I wonder what they think of us, ●.
That we're a couple, obviously.
Where do you even get that confidence from？
Kobayakawa
Did you hurry and clean up just because I was coming over？
I always keep it clean
Guess you caught me!
I always keep it clean.
Hmm. Well, I'll take your word for it.
It's unnaturally neat, you know. Better than a mess, though.
Kobayakawa
I feel kind of nervous.
Just relax
Should I make some tea？
Relax, relax! Make yourself at home.
Like there's any way I could do that.
Should I make some tea？ That ought to help you settle down.
Hehe, aren't you considerate. Don't go to any trouble, though.
Kobayakawa
I read this book a while back, too.
Thought you'd like it, ▲小早川＊▲
Oh, what a coincidence
It looked like something you'd like, ▲小早川＊▲, so I got curious.
Huh, that's actually kind of sweet. I'll lend you some more by this author.
Oh, what a coincidence.
A coincidence, huh. Guess our tastes start rubbing off on each other.
Kobayakawa
Hey, quit fidgeting.
I'm just nervous
Just admiring your nice room
I'm just nervous. Being in a girl's room kind of does that...
That kind of thing rubs off on me, you know. What a pain.
(Not like I can help it...)
I just couldn't help noticing how nice it is. Definitely a girl's room.
Quit staring at everything.
Kobayakawa
I'll make us something. Tea？ Coffee？
Tea, please
I'll take coffee
Tea, please.
Got it. One moment, my good sir.
I'll take coffee.
Coming right up, dear. ...Sorry, forget I just said that.
(Whoa...)
Kobayakawa
Wanna watch a concert DVD or something？
Oh, sounds fun!
I'd rather talk more with you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Oh, sounds great! Got any recommendations？
Hehe, obviously. Just hang on a sec.
Hmm... Well, I guess that's fine too.
